parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by allowing Dagger instances to be simplified with IdentityOperator, but it may introduce unintended behavior.

issues.description: The change may lead to unexpected behavior when multiplying Dagger instances with other operators, as it now returns the other operator directly without further simplification.
